descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
🥊 Boxing Academy VR

Master Real Boxing Skills. Train. Fight. Win.

Boxing Academy VR is more than a game—it’s an immersive boxing training experience built entirely for controller-free 🖐️ hand tracking. Throw real punches with your own hands as you learn authentic boxing techniques and put your skills to the test.

🥊 Learn Like a Boxer

Train with step-by-step lessons covering essential boxing techniques:

👊 Jab
👊 Cross
👊 Hook
👊 Uppercut
👣 Footwork and stepping
💥 Powerful punch combinations, including Jab-Cross, Body Jab-Cross, and more

⏱️ Slow down every lesson with adjustable slow-motion playback, making it easy for beginners while helping experienced players perfect their timing and technique.

🥊 Practice Your Combos

Once you've learned the basics, sharpen your skills by smashing flying combo fruits 🍎🍉. React quickly, maintain your rhythm, and build speed, accuracy, and muscle memory as you execute realistic punch combinations.

🏟️ Step Into the Ring

Ready for a real challenge? Face two powerful opponents in full boxing matches featuring authentic rounds and rest periods. Use your jabs, crosses, hooks, uppercuts, footwork, dodges, and ducks to outsmart your opponents and earn victory.

 🎃Arcade Action Included

Need a break from serious training? Jump into the original arcade mode where crazy wizards and chaotic drones 🚁 launch pumpkins 🎃 and watermelons 🍉 at you. Dodge, duck, weave, and unleash knockout punches 💥 as you smash flying targets.
